title: KoreLumina — Master OS - Repo Import Debugging

messages.content:
Current task: verify your live preview system is actually working end-to-end

Step 1 — Confirm files exist
Run:
Bashls app/api/dev/live-preview
Expected:
Bashmanager.ts
watcher.ts
route.ts
If anything missing → stop and fix.

Step 2 — Start main app
Bashnpm run dev
Make sure:


no build errors


API routes compiled



Step 3 — Trigger live preview (critical test)
Open your builder UI and select a project.
👉 This should call:
POST /api/dev/live-preview

Step 4 — Watch terminal logs
You should see:
📦 Installing dependencies... (only first run)
🚀 Launching korelumina-dogfood on 34xx
Then:
ready / started / Local:

Step 5 — Verify iframe loads
Expected result:


NOT blank


actual app renders


routes work


no supabase errors



Step 6 — Test hot reload
Edit any file inside the repo:
Bashruntime/workspaces/default/projects/<projectId>/app/page.tsx
Expected:
👀 Watching project: ...
🔁 Change detected: app/page.tsx
Then:


server killed


next request restarts it


preview updates



If something fails
Case A — preview never loads
Check:
Bashlsof -i :3400
If nothing → server didn’t start

Case B — install hangs
Run manually:
Bashcd runtime/workspaces/default/projects/<projectId>
npm install

Case C — Next never ready
Check logs for:


missing env vars


port conflicts


script mismatch



What success looks like
You now have:


real repo rendering ✅


multi-framework support ✅


auto dependency install ✅


hot reload ✅


process isolation ✅



Important checkpoint
If this works:
👉 KoreLumina is now a real runtime platform, not just a builder

Next step (only after this passes)
Say:
👉 “add UI control panel (logs + restart + status)”
That’s the final layer to make it elite-level.

Current task: fix “no project in builder” (builder is not loading projects from runtime)

What this means
Your system is now working backend-wise, but:
👉 Builder UI is not listing projects

👉 So nothing can be selected → no preview → dead flow

Root causes (one of these is happening)
1. No projects in runtime folder
2. /api/dev/fs/list not returning project list
3. Builder not reading project list correctly
4. Wrong projectId being passed

✅ Step 1 — verify projects actually exist
Run:
Bashls runtime/workspaces/default/projects
Expected:
Bashkorelumina-dogfood
repo-test

If EMPTY → that’s your problem
👉 You need to import / create a project first

✅ Step 2 — test API directly
Open browser:
http://localhost:3000/api/dev/fs/list?projectId=korelumina-dogfood
Expected:
JSON{ "files": [...] }

If this fails
Then:


FS API broken


OR wrong project path



✅ Step 3 — check BuilderClient.tsx (critical)
Your builder likely expects a projectId like:
TypeScriptconst projectId = searchParams.get("projectId") || "demo-project";

Problem
If URL has no projectId:
👉 builder loads non-existent project

✅ Fix (minimal)
Force a valid default:
TypeScriptconst projectId =
  searchParams.get("projectId") ||
  "korelumina-dogfood";

✅ Step 4 — test manually
Open:
http://localhost:3000/builder?projectId=korelumina-dogfood

Expected


file tree loads


editor shows code


preview starts



✅ Step 5 — verify file filtering logic
You wrote:
TypeScriptf.includes("page")
👉 This can hide everything if structure differs

Quick fix (temporary)
Replace filter with:
TypeScriptreturn f.endsWith(".tsx") || f.endsWith(".jsx");

⚠️ Likely your real issue
Based on your earlier logs:
GET /api/dev/fs/list?projectId=repo-test
👉 API works
BUT:
👉 Builder not selecting project properly

🔥 Fastest fix path
Do this now:
1. Open builder with explicit project
http://localhost:3000/builder?projectId=repo-test

2. If still empty → relax filter

✅ Expected outcome
You should see:


file tree populated


editor working


preview iframe active



If still broken
Then the issue is:
👉 Builder UI state logic (not backend)

Next step
If this doesn’t fix it:
👉 paste your BuilderClient.tsx
I’ll fix it clean without breaking layout.

Current task: open and verify BuilderClient.tsx

✅ Option 1 — terminal (fastest)
Run:
Bashcat app/builder/BuilderClient.tsx

If file is large (better view)
Bashnano app/builder/BuilderClient.tsx
Controls:


scroll → arrows


exit → CTRL + X



✅ Option 2 — VS Code / editor
Open:
Bashapp/builder/BuilderClient.tsx

✅ What you’re looking for (CRITICAL line)
Find something like:
TypeScriptconst projectId = searchParams.get("projectId") || "demo-project";

If you see "demo-project"
👉 That’s the problem
You don’t have a project named demo-project

✅ Fix (do this)
Change to:
TypeScriptconst projectId =
  searchParams.get("projectId") ||
  "korelumina-dogfood";

✅ Save + reload
Then open:
http://localhost:3000/builder?projectId=korelumina-dogfood

✅ What should happen


file tree loads


editor shows code


preview starts



If you don’t see that line
Then:
👉 paste the file here
I’ll fix it without breaking your builder layout.
